verdict.rationale: The SDK provides a file-system watch capability with an `onEvent` callback (inotify-based) that lets developers trigger custom actions when files change, which is a form of event-driven automation, but this is a narrow, code-level primitive rather than a declarative rules/automation engine. Missing for 10: no declarative rule-definition mechanism, no support for triggering on non-filesystem events (e.g., scheduled/cron, external webhooks, custom event types), and no evidence of a rules/condition-action system beyond raw watcher callbacks.
